# endpointcentral_custom_group_memberships_exclusive (Resource)

Owns the **complete** member list of a static or static unique custom group. Members added any other way (the console, `endpointcentral_custom_group_membership`) are removed on the next apply, and show up in the plan as drift first.

Destroying this resource stops managing the list but **leaves the members in the group**, like the AWS provider's `*_exclusive` resources. To empty the group, apply with `resource_ids = []` first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "endpointcentral_custom_group" "macos_canary" {
  name = "macos-canary"
}

# The complete member list: members added in the console are removed on the
# next apply.
resource "endpointcentral_custom_group_memberships_exclusive" "macos_canary" {
  group_id     = endpointcentral_custom_group.macos_canary.id
  resource_ids = ["2001", "2002"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID of a static or static unique custom group.
- `resource_ids` (Set of String) Resource IDs of every computer (or user) that should be in the group. `[]` empties it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The custom group ID
tofu import endpointcentral_custom_group_memberships_exclusive.macos_canary 301
```
